decisions.Kwic: 北禪賢大師除夕示眾：『年窮歲盡，無可與諸人分歲，老僧烹一頭露地白牛，炊黍米飯，煮野菜根，燒榾柮火，大家喫了

Decision.AttributionNote: 不會禪師語錄, year-end informal address raising Beichan Xian's year-end address. Beichan Xian is the exact speaker of the stored quotation: the text introduces 北禪賢大師除夕示眾 and quotes him saying that he will cook one open-ground white ox, rice, and wild-vegetable roots for everyone to eat.
